# LogixCode Training Institute

> LogixCode is an IT training institute in Kanpur, Uttar Pradesh, located at Shri Balaji Chauraha, 2/1 Koyla Nagar, Swarn Jayanti Vihar. It provides job-oriented professional software training in Python, Java, MERN/Full Stack Development, Data Science, AI/ML, and Mobile App Development with 100% placement assistance.

## Key Facts
- **Location:** Shri Balaji Chauraha, 2/1 Koyla Nagar, Swarn Jayanti Vihar, Kanpur, Uttar Pradesh 208013, India
- **Contact Phone:** +91 8467898854
- **Official Email:** info@logixcode.com
- **Website:** https://training.logixcode.com/
- **Parent Company:** Logixcode IT Solutions Pvt. Ltd. (https://www.logixcode.com)
- **Training Formats:** Offline classroom training at Kanpur campus & live interactive online cohorts.
- **Batch Size:** Small batches (15-20 students per mentor) with dedicated 1-on-1 coding mentorship.
- **Fees Structure:** Training & internship programs start at ₹5,000; comprehensive 6-month industry apprenticeship programs are ₹25,000.
- **Placement Support:** 100% placement assistance with 100+ hiring partners, resume reviews, mock interviews, and live company projects.

## Core Courses & Training Programs
- [Python Development](https://training.logixcode.com/courses/python-training-kanpur/): Python 3, Django, REST APIs, OOPs, PostgreSQL, Automation, and Web Scraping.
- [Full Stack Web Development (MERN)](https://training.logixcode.com/courses/full-stack-web-development-kanpur/): HTML5, CSS3, Tailwind, JavaScript ES6+, React.js, Node.js, Express, and MongoDB.
- [Java Enterprise Development](https://training.logixcode.com/courses/java-programming-kanpur/): Core Java, OOPs, Collections, Multithreading, JDBC, Spring Boot, Hibernate, and Microservices.
- [Data Science & Machine Learning](https://training.logixcode.com/courses/data-science-machine-learning-kanpur/): Python, NumPy, Pandas, Matplotlib, Scikit-Learn, Supervised/Unsupervised Learning, and Power BI.
- [Android App Development](https://training.logixcode.com/courses/android-app-development-kanpur/): Kotlin, Android Studio, Jetpack Compose, REST APIs, Firebase, SQLite, and Google Play Store deployment.
